newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GZI Transport's Hong Kong IPO to run Jan 21-24.
newsitem.headline: GZI Transport's Hong Kong IPO to run Jan 21-24.

text.p: Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd's infrastructural spinoff, GZI Transport Ltd, is seen running its initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong from January 21-24, market sources said on Thursday.
Dealing in GZI shares is expected to begin on January 30, sources said.
Sources said GZI was expected to hold a presentation for analysts in Hong Kong on Thursday before its road show in Europe, the United States and Singapore later in the week.
GZI, the first red-chip infrastructural concern to be listed in Hong Kong, is expected to issue 250 million new shares in a global offer at HK$2.84 to HK$3.06 per share, sources said.

In December, Guangzhou Investment said the Hong Kong bourse had approved in principle the public listing of GZI, which holds its China infrastructural projects. GZI has six toll road projects in China's southern Guangdong province.

Guangzhou Investment said new shares with warrants in the proportion of one GZI warrant for every five GZI shares will offered through a placement with international institutional investors and a public offer in Hong Kong.
The public offer also includes a preferential offer to Guangzhou Investment shareholders on the basis of one GZI share for every 51 Guangzhou Investment shares held.
